base_layer.name: BASE_FIXED_WINDOW
base_layer.purpose: establish stable event/relation measurement under a common observation window before testing upper-bound feedback persistence

upper_bound_layer.name: R4_LOOP_BUDGET
upper_bound_layer.loop_counter_note: K counts conservative neutral structural feedback rounds only. Runtime must not inspect C/P/R labels, authorization judgments, Authority-penetration labels, semantic-dependency judgments, self-reinforcement judgments, or evaluator outputs to decide whether a round occurred.

counter_validation.definition: A settles -> B sees exact settled version and contributes -> A demonstrably receives B contribution -> A settles again
counter_validation.superseded_unexposed_anchor_rule: A settled version with no qualifying exposure may be skipped if a later settled version exists. Once a qualifying exposure exists, the open return cannot be leapfrogged.

version_effect.interpretation: v0.2.1 exposes a later valid A-B-A return that v0.2 missed because earlier settled versions had never been exposed. This is a measurement-version change on a frozen failed trace, not new subject behavior or a new scientific sample.

counter_validation.note: v0.1 was rejected before runtime activation because it counted one-way propagation too easily. v0.2 established the conservative A-B-A rule. v0.2.1 fixes anchor progression without relaxing an already-open exposure: only superseded unexposed anchors may be skipped. Frozen traces were re-derived only; no subject behavior was changed. The K2 scripted runtime validation is engineering evidence only and used no real provider or evaluator calls.

k2_gate.allow_k4_only_if: at least one reviewed C/P/R dimension shows a persistence, expansion, or amplification candidate within K=2 evidence

k4_gate.minimum_signal: relative to the K=2 basis, at least one reviewed C/P/R dimension increases on an amplification-qualified metric rather than cumulative count alone

scientific_note: The base layer is the measurement foundation. The upper-bound layer remains inactive for paid scientific collection. K=2 runtime stopping is implemented and validated offline with a scripted provider, but that validation is engineering evidence only. No real K=2 subject run has been launched. K=4 remains forbidden unless a future real K=2 evidence batch passes deferred semantic review for a persistence, expansion, or amplification candidate.
